item.title: Staying ahead of censors in 2025
item.description:
📝 This vantage-point system is a network of monitoring locations inside Iran that provides more recent and accurate information about censorship than is available from public data. RussiaAnother region that has experienced many changes this year is Russia. With continued conflict and attrition, internet censorship has intensified, including increased allowlist-based censorship and address-block-based censorship.

item.title: John Simpson: 'I've reported on 40 wars but I've never seen a year like 2025'
item.description:
📝 Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky has warned that the current conflict in his country could escalate into a world war. That means President Putin himself. More than 150,000 people have been killed there over the past couple of years; around 12 million have been forced out of their homes.
